figurative_meaning_en: Friend or companion only in good times
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সুখের পায়রা, দুঃখের সময় কখনো পাশে থাকে না।
জীবনে সুখের পায়রাদের থেকে দূরে থাকাই ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a fair-weather friend, never around during tough times.
It's better to stay away from fair-weather friends in life.
note: This idiom draws from natural imagery common in Bengali folklore, symbolizing fleeting companionship.
